b: I've (embarrassingly) been working on this project for 2 years so wanted to finally share (as I saw others posting Youtube-only versions).
on Youtube it transcribes text to identify checkable claims -> web search retrieves sources to base Claude's verdict on, to avoid hallucinated sources.
it's a free Chrome extension, and works on news or social media sites as well.
let me know what would make this something you'd use, or what else you'd like to see!
LogicLens - Chrome Webstore or on iOS if you don't use Chrome.
Edit: I realized someone not following could misread the video (here Biden was correct, and Trump was incorrect, but the Trump section is before I started the recording).
